verdict.rationale: Browserbase documents first-party webhooks that send an HTTP POST to a user-owned endpoint when a subscribed event happens. Endpoints can be registered from Settings or through the SDK, and the docs cover signature verification for deliveries. missing for 10: an enumerated catalog of subscribable event types, independent or hands-on corroboration of webhook delivery.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can subscribe to events via webhooks

citations.quote: Browserbase webhooks send an HTTP POST to an endpoint you own as soon as a subscribed event happens, so you don't have to poll the API for status changes.
You can manage endpoints from Settings as well as through the SDK. Both act on the same webhooks.
Verify the signature on every request and reject anything that fails.
